payload.summary: CP-HARDEN-01 implemented and merged via PR #93. Transactional compare-and-swap mutation inbox, quarantine receipts, and per-lane projection incident isolation are operational.
payload.next_action: Migrate mutating automation state writes to the transactional inbox, then proceed to CP-HARDEN-02 resource-level conflict locks.
decisions: Operational API writers must not edit workstream or canonical-state JSON directly on main.
Invalid or stale mutation requests are quarantined without changing lane state.
Unreadable lanes are isolated in projection_incidents instead of blinding healthy lanes.
